prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A modern, ultra-minimalist office bathed in bright, diffuse natural light, with a predominantly white color palette that creates a clean, futuristic atmosphere. In the foreground, a middle-aged man with short dark hair, a trimmed beard, and glasses sits at a sleek white desk, turning in surprise to look over his shoulder. He wears a light gray t-shirt and a red wristwatch, his expression a mix of shock and curiosity, mouth slightly open as if caught off guard. His hands hover above a compact keyboard and mouse, positioned in front of a large, thin computer monitor displaying a dark-themed interface with technical graphics and code. The background features soft-focus white furniture, potted green plants, and geometric architectural lines, enhancing the sense of spaciousness and modernity. Another figure, partially visible on the right, stands close to the man, dressed in a green jacket, adding a subtle narrative tension. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to keep the focus on the man’s reaction, with high-key lighting and crisp details that evoke a cinematic, high-tech ambiance.
